mapper.select: SELECT l.id AS lot_id, l.item_id AS item_id, l.expiry_date AS expiry_date, COALESCE(SUM(sp.quantity), 0) AS total_qty FROM inventory_lot l LEFT JOIN inventory_stock_position sp ON sp.lot_id = l.id AND sp.household_id = l.household_id WHERE l.household_id = #{householdId} AND l.item_id = #{itemId} GROUP BY l.id, l.item_id, l.expiry_date

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sp.quantity), 0) FROM inventory_stock_position sp JOIN inventory_lot l ON l.id = sp.lot_id AND l.household_id = sp.household_id WHERE sp.household_id = #{householdId} AND l.item_id = #{itemId}
